rav-shimi-bar-ziri.name: Rav Shimi bar Ziri
rav-shimi-bar-ziri.bio: Amora who taught a baraita before Rav Pappa on sin offerings left to die or to graze (Temurah 24a).
rav-shimi-bar-ziri.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short dark beard and a plain brown wool mantle, reciting a teaching from memory with one hand raised to keep its rhythm; background of a Babylonian study hall with mud-brick walls and a single oil lamp.
